title: Le bilan du repas de quartier
summary: Volunteers compare two fictional event totals, then explain why a lower amount of waste does not prove which change caused it.

sentences.fr: Après un repas de quartier, l'équipe a pesé les restes pour vérifier si son nouveau système de portions aidait.
sentences.en: After a neighbourhood meal, the team weighed leftovers to check whether its new portion system helped.

sentences.fr: Lors du premier événement, elle avait mesuré vingt-quatre kilogrammes de déchets; au suivant, elle en a mesuré dix-huit.
sentences.en: At the first event, it had measured twenty-four kilograms of waste; at the next, it measured eighteen.

sentences.fr: La différence était de six kilogrammes, mais le deuxième repas avait accueilli moins de personnes.
sentences.en: The difference was six kilograms, but the second meal had fewer attendees.

sentences.fr: De plus, les bénévoles avaient aussi changé la taille des contenants et donné les surplus à une autre activité.
sentences.en: In addition, volunteers had also changed container sizes and given surplus food to another activity.

sentences.fr: Le bilan signalait donc une baisse mesurée sans attribuer tout le changement au nouveau système.
sentences.en: The review therefore reported a measured decrease without attributing all of the change to the new system.

sentences.fr: L'équipe a décidé de noter le nombre de repas servis et les quantités transférées lors du prochain essai.
sentences.en: The team decided to record the number of meals served and the amounts transferred during the next trial.

sentences.fr: Elle pourrait alors comparer des événements plus semblables avant de recommander une pratique permanente.
sentences.en: It could then compare more similar events before recommending a permanent practice.
sentences.note: A measured difference is not automatically proof of cause; compare similar events and track other changes that could affect the result.

quiz.prompt: What was the difference between the two waste measurements?
quiz.explain: The text gives 24 kilograms for the first event and 18 for the second.

quiz.prompt: Why could the team not attribute the full change to the portion system?
options: The team had not weighed anything
Attendance and other practices also changed
The second event served more people
quiz.explain: The second event had fewer people and volunteers changed other practices.

quiz.prompt: What will the team record during the next trial?
options: Opinions from people who did not attend
The cost of every volunteer's commute
quiz.explain: The sixth sentence lists what the team will record.
